Olaf desktop runtime source distribution
=======================================

Olaf (Overly Lightweight Acoustic Fingerprinting)
Copyright (C) 2019-2025 Joren Six (see individual source files).
https://github.com/JorenSix/Olaf
License: GNU Affero General Public License version 3 or, at your option, later.
The full license is LICENSE in source and OLAF-LICENSE in the runtime package.
All original file-level notices are retained. This component is NOT MIT.

Modifications captured and distributed on 2026-10-29:
- Windows LMDB path suffix compatibility fix.
- Experimental saturated-hash skipping and independent-time voting flags,
  config/CLI/schema parity, safe unsigned matcher bounds, allocation guards,
  failed LMDB cursor seek guard and corresponding regressions.
- Local Zigzag dependency; release source inventory/test gates; offline-only
  dataset fixture validation; synthetic path in a legacy test.
See PROVENANCE.json and patches/olaf in the matching source distribution for
exact modified files, revision IDs, hashes and an ordered patch series.
No extraction algorithm/default changes were introduced by the release patch.
Process separation is not a blanket conclusion about distribution licensing.

Embedded components (their source notices remain authoritative):

LMDB: src/mdb.c, src/midl.c, src/lmdb.h, src/midl.h
Copyright 2011-2020 Howard Chu, Symas Corp.
Copyright 2000-2020 The OpenLDAP Foundation.
Portions Copyright 2001-2020 Howard Chu, Symas Corp.
Derived portions Copyright (c) 2009, 2010 Martin Hedenfalk.
OpenLDAP Public License 2.8 and the embedded permissive btree notice.
Full texts: notices/OpenLDAP-LICENSE.txt, LMDB-mdb-NOTICE.txt,
LMDB-midl-NOTICE.txt. The OpenLDAP license was supplied from the license URL
identified in the embedded source (the original Olaf root LICENSE is AGPL).
https://www.openldap.org/software/release/license.html

PFFFT / FFTPACK: src/pffft.c, src/pffft.h
Copyright (c) 2013 Julien Pommier; based on FFTPACKv4 by Paul Swarztrauber,
NCAR (1985); Copyright (c) 2004 University Corporation for Atmospheric
Research (UCAR). BSD-style FFTPACK terms, reproduced from both original files
in notices/PFFFT-NOTICE.txt and notices/PFFFT-header-NOTICE.txt.

c-algorithms: src/hash-table.c/.h and src/queue.c/.h
Copyright (c) 2005-2008 Simon Howard. ISC terms are reproduced in
notices/c-algorithms-NOTICE.txt and in all four source files.

Zigzag 0.1.2, revision e16e2523972d174d7ca9783631cc90e2609fa55e
Copyright (c) 2026 Matthew Meszaros. MIT license.
https://github.com/meszmate/zigzag
Source: sibling vendor/zigzag; source license: vendor/zigzag/LICENSE.
Runtime license copy: notices/Zigzag-LICENSE.txt.

Toolchain-provided code: builds require Zig 0.16.0. The Zig contributor MIT
license, mingw-w64 COPYING and musl COPYRIGHT shipped with that toolchain are
reproduced in notices/Zig-LICENSE.txt, mingw-w64-COPYING.txt and
musl-COPYRIGHT.txt. They are notices, not vendored toolchains. Applicability
depends on target/linking; the release owner must audit any additional emitted
CRT/system-library subcomponent terms and SDK requirements. These copies do
not replace that binary-specific audit.

FFmpeg/FFprobe: external subprocess tools, not linked or included here. Their
license/build configuration and corresponding source must be handled by any
distributor that chooses to bundle them.

See BUILDING.md for source boundaries, omitted audio/test fixtures, and the
unverified-target-build status. No user music, user indexes, prebuilt Olaf
executables, credentials or machine-specific settings are part of this source.

Additional Local Shazam distribution modifications (2026-11-01):
- Release build privacy flags and install/debug policy (patches 0004 and 0005).
- Windows x86: bounded 512 MiB LMDB map, explicit 64-bit fingerprint comparisons,
  alignment-safe reads and checked writes, plus regression coverage (patch 0006).
- Windows x86 CLI: MinGW architecture macro and mutex-protected 64-bit temporary
  counters (patch 0007). These changes do not retune fingerprint extraction.
- Updated x86 build instructions and this modification summary in the beta source
  distribution. Original upstream authors, notices and licenses remain unchanged.
See PROVENANCE.json, BUILDING.md and the seven ordered source patches for exact
source correspondence. Local Shazam original application copyright: 2026 badger;
this attribution does not claim ownership of Olaf or its third-party components.
